mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may reduce the contraceptive efficacy of medroxyprogesterone through inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis and potential effects on progestin metabolism, while increasing gastrointestinal and bleeding risks.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding and consider alternative analgesia; counsel on backup contraception if using medroxyprogesterone for contraceptive purposes; assess GI risk factors and consider gastroprotection.
